{{Quote|Two Mystics and a team of Voss Commandos are missing.|[[Jiri-Su]]|<ref name="TOR:SoS" />}}
A '''battle''' took place in the [[Shrine of Silence]], on the planet [[Voss]], during the [[Third Galactic War]]. The [[Voss commandos|Voss commando]] [[Jiri-Su]] requested the assistance of the [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]] of the [[Eternal Alliance]] in order to rescue two [[Voss Mystics]], [[Rada-Ki]] and [[Tem-Su]], and a group of Voss commandos that disappeared in the depths of the shrine. The Alliance Commander eventually discovered that all individuals and creatures that entered the Shrine of Silence had been corrupted by an ancient and powerful [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]] known as [[the Curse]].<ref name="TOR:SoS" />
